reviews.text: Poorly run location that dismisses safety concerns and attacks your character when you bring up feedback about it also the front desk staff at this location are constantly changing with high turnover rates and it has caused a decline in quality care. I also warn pet owners that this vet has a habit of mis diagnosing and pushing unnecessary treatments onto their clients. Furthermore when reporting issues about this location the manager named Laura will call you and make sure that you are aware that she isn’t sorry in the slightest about anything and that it’s your fault & gaslighting you for everything that happened. After spending thousands of dollars upwards of 25k I am left looking for another vet that isn’t an empty corporate shell.
Modern Animal has been an awesome place for our fur babies! Extra shout out to Nurse Katana for being the absolute best and taking such great care of Kitty today. Thank you : )

I needed to take my senior cat for some kidney level testing, and it was such an easy and fast! Nurse Katana was so incredibly kind and helpful, and was able to complete all testing in less than 10 minutes. My cat came back calm, cool, and very happy about getting a little treat. Thank you Nurse Katana and the Modern Animal team for taking care of my baby!

Modern Animal is the only way to go for vet care for your furry friends. Or maybe feathered or scaled friends too, but you’ll have to check. Staff is always friendly. At this location a wonderful tech, Katana, helped cut my squirmy dog and my nervous dog’s nails!
Everyone was so kind and professional, really lovely place ❤️

Modern Animal is truly the best vet! Everyone is incredibly welcoming, caring, helpful, and professional. This morning, they even had my kitty’s name on the door waiting for her consultation, which I thought was such a thoughtful and personal touch. 🥹

They were so patient and gentle with her throughout the entire visit, and it really made me feel like she was in the best hands. You can tell they genuinely care about their patients and their owners. I couldn’t recommend Modern Animal more! ❤️🐾

One of the most upsetting experiences I have ever had at a veterinary clinic.

I rarely leave reviews like this, but the way I was treated at the West Hollywood location - particularly by a technician named Bianca - was so lacking in empathy and professionalism that I feel other pet owners should know about it.

I brought my cat in because she had developed a circular skin lesion that looked similar to ringworm. The veterinarian told me it could be ringworm, bacteria, or something else and recommended testing.

My cat has had ringworm before, so I asked whether they could first check the lesion with a Wood’s lamp. I was honestly surprised that I had to suggest this myself. They eventually did it, the lesion did not fluoresce, and they proceeded with bacterial cytology. I was told there was some bacteria, but not enough to warrant oral antibiotics at this point, so they prescribed a topical cream.

I asked questions about that decision. I want to make this very clear: I did not refuse treatment, and I was not demanding that they prescribe antibiotics. I was asking questions because I wanted to understand the treatment plan for my cat.

Bianca was visibly irritated while speaking to me. Eventually, I told her directly that I felt she was not being nice to me.

Her response was: “Oh that’s okay.”

I told her, no, actually, it is not okay. Then I tried to explain that I was anxious and asking a lot of questions, because I just lost my other cat and was traumatized by that experience.

Only two months earlier, I had brought another one of my cats to this clinic with an ear infection. At that time, I was similarly told that oral antibiotics were not necessary yet and that we should start with topical treatment. My cat passed within 2 weeks.

I was NOT telling Bianca that the clinic killed my cat. I was NOT blaming her, the veterinarian, or anyone else for my cat’s death. I was explaining this experience because losing my cat was traumatic for me and because it explained why I was scared and asking so many questions.

Her response?

She raised her voice and said, “You’ve been rude to us all day, and now you’re blaming us for killing your cat.”

I was absolutely stunned.

I had never said anything remotely like that. She took one of the most painful experiences I have gone through, completely twisted what I had said, and threw it back at me while I was sitting there worried about another one of my animals.

When I immediately told her that I had NEVER accused anyone of killing my cat and that I had only shared the story to explain why I was scared, she did not attempt to de-escalate the situation or show any empathy. She simply left the room with an attitude.

I was so shaken that I asked to speak with a manager before leaving.
Other team members stepped out to speak with me to understand what happened. I started crying so badly, so I couldn't even breath. They assured me that the manager will contact me later to address this issue.

And somehow, the experience became even more disappointing afterward: nobody ever followed up with me.

No call. No explanation. No apology. Nothing.

My issue here is not that the veterinarian recommended topical medication.

If a client tells you that they recently lost their animal, is visibly emotional, and explains that this is why they are anxious, the appropriate response is not “that’s okay” when they tell you you’re being unkind. And it certainly is not to raise your voice and accuse them of “blaming us for killing your cat” when those words never came out of their mouth.

Veterinary medicine deals with people during some of the most vulnerable moments of their lives. Basic empathy should not be an unreasonable expectation.

The fact that this happened was unacceptable. The fact that management never even bothered to follow up after I reported it made it worse.

Based on this experience, I cannot recommend the West Hollywood location to anyone who expects compassionate communication, professionalism, or accountability when something goes wrong.

Have tried to call multiple times no answer- showed up this morning at 9 am : sign says “open” but stood outside ringing the door bell for a couple minutes before realizing its a ghost office- never going back

If your pet is healthy or can be solely treated at Modern Animal then this vet option is fine. For any emergencies or if a specialist needs to get in touch with a doctor here, Modern Animal is absolutely awful. I don’t understand what my membership pays for when I get responses through the app in 2-3 business days.

For context, my dog had to have an emergency stent placed due to a collapsed trachea. The surgeon that performed this had a lot of questions for her cardiologist and what type of medicine he would be ok prescribing due to her heart issues. It’s been 6 weeks since her surgery and he nor I have been able to get in contact with her cardiologist (or any doctor for that matter), just the customer service reps. She also routinely sees an eye doctor and he also has tried to get in touch with her primary doctor to no avail. I have literally spent tens of thousands of dollars at this place with all 3 of my dogs and I find this exceptionally unacceptable.

I would never recommend Modern Animal to anyone. Pick a local vet, not a revolving door.
